about: Public description of trainer-host-v835-64k (NOT a ROOT-signed admission). Derived from live host-v834c/v834d. Adds ZeRO-2-style sharded FP32 gradient accumulation + post-accumulate BF16 grad disposal so a single 65536-output / 69632-context rollout can train on 8xH200 without changing GRPO/support-renorm/fresh-adam-normgrad math.
model_class: transformers 5.14.1 Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (hybrid GDN + full attention, vocab 248320)
trainable: model.language_model.* and lm_head.* (vision tower and MTP heads frozen)

memory_fix.v834c_problem: full actor replica + eager FP32 accumulator (~36 GB) + BF16 param grads (~18 GB) per GPU; 64K activations push past ~140 GiB H200
memory_fix.v835_change: shard FP32 accumulators across ranks (reduce-to-owner); free BF16 grads via register_post_accumulate_grad_hook; singleton bins for >=65536-token rollouts; optional activation_offload
memory_fix.expected_static_64k_gib_per_gpu: ~40 GiB before attention/FLA/NCCL workspaces (see memory_estimate.py); ample vs 139.8 GiB H200 allocator

qualification.note: Unsigned experimental host. Do not deploy live until 8xH200 qual JSON is green and ROOT re-admits a signed bundle.
